behavior_notes: Framing, CRC32-C and codec errors still fail the whole response before any record is applied.
Errors found only while decompressing or decoding records now surface when that batch is applied; a corrupt batch past the budget is reported by the later fetch that reaches it.
The fetch is still over-requested: about 13x the consumed bytes are fetched because batches past the budget are re-fetched (KL10-17).
